videos.title: Red Color Gajalakshmi
videos.description: Red-Color Gajalakshmi is introduced here. if you are createing the Plum color watch start from Painting Step1: First Coat video.

videos.title: Painting Clear Coat
videos.description: Learn to prep the canvas for painting. Applying a Clear Coat of Gesso is a very important step, do not skip. The Canvas should be FLAT before you start, so make sure you have weighted in on a flat surface for TWO(2) days.

videos.title: Painting Step1: First Coat
videos.description: Learn how to apply the first coat of paint.

videos.title: Mixing Without a Dropper
videos.description: Alternate paint mixing method without a dropper is shown here.

videos.title: End First Coat and Brush Cleaning
videos.description: See what my first coat looks like finished and clean your brushes the right way for proper maintenance.

videos.title: Detailing Brush and Painting Edges
videos.description: Use your detailing brush to paint the endges and details.
